text: BAM's share of Solana stake eased to 27.9% (121.5M SOL) over the past 25 hours. Just 3 of the 13 live nodes hold a majority of marketplace stake, with the largest at 29.9% and 87 validators concentrated on the busiest node in fra. The top node by stake changed hands 69 times in this window — whale-driven routing, not structural rollovers.
